lines.text: The LORD will come with fire and judge all flesh by fire and by His sword.
Those who purify themselves to enter the groves and eat the flesh of swine will perish together.
The LORD will gather all nations to see His glory and send survivors to Tarshish, Put, and Lud.
They will bring all your brothers on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels to Bethel, and some will become priests and Levites.
All mankind will worship from one New Moon to another, and the rebels' fire will be quenched.
